lead_headline: Zero new restaurant leads detected for first time this month as Denver's opening season hits Sunday pause

restaurant.blurb: No new leads today. Active pipeline holds at 113 (57 openings, 56 closures) — most recent: Ultra Lounge West (Westminster karaoke lounge) and Taqueria La Morenas closure (Harvey Park).

foreclosure.blurb: $6.1M Douglas County property at 18901 Longs Way remains this week's sole filing exceeding $4M — scheduled for Thursday auction.

liquor.blurb: No new applications today, but 4 status changes signal enforcement activity: East Tao and Mellow Mushroom licenses expired after delinquency, while Corks LoHi and Park Burger Highlands slipped to delinquent status. The 21-application weekly pace maintains momentum from last week's surge, though zero Sunday filings suggest the State's processing backlog has cleared — weekly volume now running 133% above the pre-March baseline of 9 applications per week.

reputation.blurb: 1 mention today pushes the 7-day count to 45 across 14 sources — down 17% from last week's 54-mention benchmark. Denver Post (10) and Instagram (10) split the week's distribution, followed by Hoodline (5), X (5), and Facebook (4). Week-over-week volume contracted modestly after three consecutive weeks above 50 mentions, suggesting April's development news cycle has normalized. Notable pickups: RiNo Triangle Tower groundbreaking coverage, Stomp Athletics Shark Tank deal, and Denver Pavilions survival analysis.

subscriptions.blurb: Net +2 yesterday (2 new, 0 canceled) pushes MTD to +18 (+1.0/day), 90-day net to +141. This week's +9 net (21 new, 12 canceled) trails last week's +11 performance by 18%, though both weeks delivered identical 21-subscriber acquisition volume — the gap stems from 33% higher cancellations (12 vs 9). Recent two-week volatility persists: April 5-11 produced +10 net before April 12-18's choppy −1/+6/−1/+1/+2 sequence. MTD's +1.0/day pace continues lagging YTD's +1.4/day average as mid-month churn offsets early-April momentum, though yesterday's clean +2 suggests Sunday stabilization.
